title: Ordinary resolution towers and smooth-functorial contraction comparisons
statement:
A rational resolution input is a reduced scheme $S$ [def-pc-reduced-scheme] equipped with a finite-type structure morphism $S\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], without a separatedness assumption. An ordinary blowup tower over $S$ is a finite sequence $S_n\to\cdots\to S_0$, an identification $S_0\simeq S$, and quasi-coherent ideal sheaves $I_i$ on $S_i$ with specified identifications $S_{i+1}\simeq\operatorname{Bl}_{I_i}(S_i)$ over $S_i$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Its transition maps compose in the indicated order. It is a regular resolution if every $I_i$ is locally finitely generated, $V(I_i)$ is nonempty, nowhere dense and regular, and $S_n$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme].

For $h:T\to S$ and towers $A$ over $S$ and $B$ over $T$, a contracted pullback comparison consists of an increasing embedding $r:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of retained stages, a monotone count $c:\{0,\ldots,n\}\to\{0,\ldots,m\}$ with $c(0)=0$, $c(n)=m$, $c(r(k))=k$, $c(r(k)+1)=k+1$, and $c(i+1)=c(i)$ for deleted stages, together with maps $B_{c(i)}\to A_i$ over $h$. Each square with $T\to S$ is cartesian, and these maps commute with the tower transitions. The ideal of the $k$-th stage of $B$, transported by $c(r(k))=k$, equals the extension of $I_{r(k)}$ along $B_{c(r(k))}\to A_{r(k)}$. A stage $i$ is deleted if and only if its extended ideal is the unit ideal.

A smooth-functorial ordinary resolution rule assigns such a regular resolution tower to every rational resolution input, including finite disjoint unions, and a contracted pullback comparison to every smooth morphism $h:T\to S$ over $\mathbf Q$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Its comparison counts and level maps are identities for identity morphisms and compose for composite smooth morphisms (with the equality transports on level indices). For every surjective smooth $h$, the retained-stage embedding is surjective, so no stage is deleted.

reviewed_lean.note: Both files (OrdinaryResolutionRule, SmoothFunctorialOrdinaryResolution) compile clean via nt_compile --json (3.0 s/2.0 s); a broken-identifier control fails as expected. Every node clause is rendered: single Nonempty rule over reduced finite-type Q-schemes with no separatedness; blowup tower with initial iso, transitions and blowupIso/blowup_fac; ofFiniteType, nonempty, nowhere-dense and regular centers (support = V(I)); regular last level; for every smooth h a comparison with count/retainedStage order data, IsPullback at every level, naturality, retained_ideal via IdealSheafData.comap (extended ideal), deleted_iff_unit (ILO 2.1.4 empty blowup = unit ideal); identity/composition count and map laws; surjective h deletes no stage. Level maps are determined by the cartesian squares (blowups have no automorphisms over the base, ILO 2.3.4), so they are not free arrows. Edge cases (length 0, empty scheme, open restriction, mixed dimension, universes) OK. No duplicate notion (fan/log towers differ). New def node has the section-5 fields; item record changes only lean plus stmt_deps; signatures verbatim; H9 imports map to proof_deps. Advisory: the second reading is the author's own; the node's grep search record covers Mathlib only.
